sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 21 (#20) and Internal Quality Checks row 21 (#20, no extra annotation/comment)
evidence: solve.sh only copies the committed solution/app tree into /app (cp -a); no build, generation or fetch. Frozen solution bytes equal the git-tracked projects/kittle-matter-chat/solution files (cmp server.js, app.js, seed_data.json, solve.sh), and the solution seed is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json. server.js takes its only time source from seed.clock (lines 32-33, CLOCK=2026-05-12T11:00:00Z, matching integration.md:7); new messages, edits, versions, retention sweep (line 143) and transcript 'Generated' line all use CLOCK, never Date.now. Message ids come from a persisted counter starting at max seed id + 1 (nextSeedNumber/newMessageId), seq is AUTOINCREMENT, seed insertion is sorted by distinct timestamps (18 messages, no duplicate 'at'), so ordering is stable. Randomness is confined to non-graded values: password salts (line 98), session tokens (line 301) and client idempotency keys (app.js:7). No boot-time network fetch; deps pinned express@5.1.0 / better-sqlite3@12.4.1 in both images. Actual run: two fresh boots of the frozen solution in hireops-agent:20261001-final (node 22, same pinned deps, --network none, container auto-removed) with a probe that signed in every seed account, read all visible matters, transcripts, mentions, search, posted one message, then dumped all DB tables (excluding salts/sessions): outputs were byte-identical (64,132 bytes), new id K-19 both times, transcript 'Generated 2026-05-12 11:00 UTC'.
